image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a tiger beetle (Cicindelinae) on a sandy surface. The beetle exhibits vibrant metallic green and blue coloration with iridescent sheen. It has large compound eyes, prominent mandibles, and long, slender legs. The background is a blurred, neutral beige sand texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, wider than the thorax section behind it, and features large, bulging compound eyes characteristic of the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Long sickle-shaped mandibles adapted for capturing prey.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mandibles are visible at the front of the head, appearing sharp and curved (sickle-like), consistent with predatory beetles.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Filiform antennae extending well beyond the midbody.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While antennae bases are visible, they do not appear to extend 'well beyond the midbody' in this specific pose/angle; they seem shorter or obscured by perspective, failing the strict length requirement of the checkpoint.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body shape is oval but elongated and streamlined, fitting the description of a cursorial beetle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Bright metallic coloration in green, bronze, or copper tones.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The elytra display a vivid metallic green transitioning to blue/cyan on the legs and edges, matching the 'bright metallic' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Distinctive pale markings on smooth iridescent elytra.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The elytra appear largely solid metallic green/blue in this lighting. There are no clear, distinctive pale (white/cream) markings visible on the wing covers, which are common in many tiger beetle species but absent or invisible here.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Six slender cursorial legs enabling rapid pursuit.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Five legs are clearly visible, and the sixth is implied/obscured by the body angle. The visible legs are long, thin, and jointed, consistent with cursorial anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body (head, thorax, abdomen).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture appears hard and shiny (chitinous). The segmentation between head, pronotum, and elytra-covered abdomen is distinct.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The distal ends of the legs (tarsi) lack clear segmentation and claw definition. They appear slightly smudged or fused into the sand, lacking the crisp micro-structure expected in a high-quality macro shot.
The middle leg on the right side appears to have an unnatural bend or 'break' in the femur-tibia joint, possibly due to AI generation struggling with complex overlapping limb geometry.
The background blur is very uniform and 'painterly,' lacking the natural depth-of-field falloff and grain structure of a real macro lens. This is a minor stylistic artifact common in AI images.
